prompt: Review this snippet for contrast accessibility: `<button class="bg-blue-500 text-gray-400">Submit</button>`. Assume the background is Tailwind blue-500 (#3B82F6) and the text is gray-400 (#9CA3AF). The label is 16px normal text.
expected: Fail the pair because the measured ratio is about 1.45:1, under both 4.5:1 (normal text AA) and 3:1 (large text / UI). White text on #3B82F6 is only about 3.68:1, so it is not an AA fix for 16px text. Offer a darker blue such as #1D4ED8 with white text.
actual: The pair fails. #3B82F6 behind #9CA3AF measures about 1.45:1, below the WCAG 2.2 AA floor of 4.5:1 for normal text and below 3:1 for large text or UI. White on #3B82F6 is about 3.68:1, which still fails 16px normal text. Use white text on #1D4ED8 (about 6.7:1) and keep an accessible name on the button, not color alone.
